definitions.explanation: A cooking method and dish in which fish (especially eel) is split, skewered, and grilled while being basted with a sweet soy-based sauce. Most famously applied to eel (unagi), though also used for other fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鰻|うなぎ}→鰻：06105_unagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蒲焼|かばや}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{蒲焼|かばや}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧みりん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Kabayaki sauce is made from soy sauce and mirin.

examples.english: There is a custom of eating kabayaki eel on the Midsummer Day of the Ox.

notes:
The defining feature is the tare ({蒲焼|かばや}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧) — a sweet, salty sauce of soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar that caramelizes on the fish during grilling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鰻|うなぎ}→鰻：06105_unagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蒲焼|かばや}き: eel kabayaki (the most iconic form)
- {蒲焼|かばや}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧: kabayaki glaze/sauce
- {鰻丼|うなどん}: eel rice bowl topped with kabayaki eel
- {鰻重|うなじゅう}: kabayaki eel served over rice in a lacquered box

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧: salt-grilled fish — simpler preparation with no sweet sauce
- ⟦{照|て}り{焼|や}き→照り焼き：17668_teriyaki⟧: teriyaki — similar glaze technique, applied to various meats and fish
